scenarios.title: A｜提醒
scenarios.setting: 朋友一个月前向玩家借了钱，说两周内会还，但一直没有提起。

turns.prompt: 你想提醒对方之前借款的事，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, just a reminder about the money I lent you last month.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, just a reminder about the money I lent you last month.
feedback.explanation: “just a reminder”轻轻提醒一件已知事项，常用于约定日期或付款期限。

choices.text: Hey, do you remember the money you borrowed from me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, do you remember the money you borrowed from me?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Just checking in about the money from last month.

feedback.naturalExpression: Just checking in about the money from last month.
feedback.explanation: “checking in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: When you get a chance, could you send me the money you owe me?

feedback.naturalExpression: When you get a chance, could you send me the money you owe me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: When will you return my money?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, just a reminder about the money I lent you last month.
feedback.explanation: 这句可以问还钱日期；朋友间初次提醒用“pay me back”更口语，也可先提到是哪笔钱。

turns.text: Oh God, yes. I’m sorry. I completely forgot.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No worries. I just wanted to remind you.

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. I just wanted to remind you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: It’s okay. Could you send it over sometime this week?

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s okay. Could you send it over sometime this week?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: That’s fine. I figured it might’ve slipped your mind.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. I figured it might’ve slipped your mind.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

turns.text: Yeah, I’ll send it as soon as I can.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks, I appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks, I appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Great. Just let me know when you’ve sent it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Just let me know when you’ve sent it.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

scenarios.title: B｜明确要求还钱
scenarios.setting: 又过了两周，对方还是没有还。

turns.prompt: 关于「朋友借钱不还」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Hey, I need to follow up about the money you owe me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I need to follow up about the money you owe me.
feedback.explanation: “follow up”表示跟进此前的事项；带上具体事项，对方就知道要查询哪次沟通。

choices.text: I really need you to pay me back now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really need you to pay me back now.
feedback.explanation: “pay me back”表示还钱，“back”明确是归还之前借出的款项。

choices.text: It’s been over a month, and I need the money back.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s been over a month, and I need the money back.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Can you tell me exactly when you’ll be able to repay me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you tell me exactly when you’ll be able to repay me?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: You need to give my money back immediately.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I need to follow up about the money you owe me.
feedback.explanation: “immediately”要求立刻还钱，语气很强；若有明确期限，直接说需要哪天收到会更好执行。

turns.text: I’m sorry. Money’s been really tight lately.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand, but I need you to give me a clear date.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but I need you to give me a clear date.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I get that, but you originally said you’d pay me back two weeks ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I get that, but you originally said you’d pay me back two weeks ago.
feedback.explanation: “pay me back”表示还钱，“back”明确是归还之前借出的款项。

choices.text: If you can’t pay it all at once, we can talk about paying it back in parts.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you can’t pay it all at once, we can talk about paying it back in parts.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I’m willing to work something out, but I can’t keep waiting without a plan.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m willing to work something out, but I can’t keep waiting without a plan.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

turns.text: Could I give you half this Friday and the rest next month?

turns.prompt: 关于「朋友借钱不还」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Yes, that works for me. Let’s do that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that works for me. Let’s do that.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: That’s fine, as long as we stick to those dates.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine, as long as we stick to those dates.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Okay. Half on Friday, and the rest next month.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Half on Friday, and the rest next month.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

scenarios.title: C｜朋友继续找借口
scenarios.setting: 到了约好的还款日，朋友再次表示还不了。

turns.text: I’m really sorry. Something unexpected came up again. Can I pay you next month instead?

turns.prompt: 关于「朋友借钱不还」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: We’ve already moved the date several times. I can’t keep doing this.

feedback.naturalExpression: We’ve already moved the date several times. I can’t keep doing this.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I understand things happen, but you need to take responsibility for paying me back.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand things happen, but you need to take responsibility for paying me back.
feedback.explanation: “take responsibility”表示承担责任；谈工作问题时，可以据此明确谁负责哪一部分。

choices.text: You told me Friday for sure. What’s changed?

feedback.naturalExpression: You told me Friday for sure. What’s changed?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: I need us to agree on a repayment plan you can actually stick to.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need us to agree on a repayment plan you can actually stick to.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: You’re obviously never going to pay me back.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: We’ve already moved the date several times. I can’t keep doing this.
feedback.explanation: “never”提前断定对方永远不会还钱；要求明确还款日期，比猜测意图更有用。

turns.text: I’m not trying to avoid paying you. I just don’t have enough right now.

turns.prompt: 关于「朋友借钱不还」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Then let’s agree on an amount you can realistically pay each week.

feedback.naturalExpression: Then let’s agree on an amount you can realistically pay each week.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Okay, but I need more than another promise.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, but I need more than another promise.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Even if you can’t pay everything, I need you to start paying some of it back.

feedback.naturalExpression: Even if you can’t pay everything, I need you to start paying some of it back.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: I want to believe you, but this has happened too many times now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to believe you, but this has happened too many times now.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

turns.text: I could probably send you a quarter of it today.

turns.prompt: 关于「朋友借钱不还」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Okay. Send that today, and then let’s agree on dates for the rest.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Send that today, and then let’s agree on dates for the rest.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: That’s a start. When can you make the next payment?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s a start. When can you make the next payment?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: Fine, but I need us to stick to the new plan this time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Fine, but I need us to stick to the new plan this time.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

turns.text: I understand. I’m sorry this has dragged on so long.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: I appreciate the apology. I just want us to get this resolved.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate the apology. I just want us to get this resolved.
feedback.explanation: “I just want”强调自己真正希望解决的事，能把讨论拉回具体诉求。

choices.text: Okay. Let’s stick to the plan from here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let’s stick to the plan from here.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。
